card.name: Dose words in dose-adjustment advice
card.fires_on: The word dose, dosage, or the start of dosing (dos, ose) when the text talks about adjusting, reducing or recommending a dose, often for kidney or liver impairment or drug interactions.

modes.label: Dose word before adjustment
modes.description: Dose or dosage as the subject of an adjustment, reduction or monitoring statement.
